Subject: POC kickoff coordination — proposed windows (AE + SE + Eng + Procurement + Security)

Hi Aaron / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. We want to lock in a 90-minute POC kickoff to cover: success criteria, timeline/milestones, owning teams, and acceptance gates (security/procurement checklist). To make sure the right people attend, proposed windows next week (PST):

- Tue 11/24, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 11/25, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 11/26, 09:00–10:30

Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & roles (10m) — AE + SE + FinOptics engineers + procurement/security reps
2) Success criteria & data flows (25m) — define acceptance tests
3) Timeline & milestone owners (25m) — who owns each gate
4) Security and procurement asks (20m) — outstanding artifacts and expected SLAs
5) Next steps & calendar invites (10m)

I attached a one-pager with draft success criteria and a mutual action plan template to speed the meeting. If those windows don't work, please send two windows that include your security and procurement reps and we'll find a match.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this kicked off.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Priya — Thu 11/26 09:00 PST works for our SE calendar. A couple of asks from engineering/SE side before kickoff:

- Can FinOptics confirm a primary SE/engineer who owns the test data and a point of contact for networking (VPC/inbound access)?
- We recommend sharing the data sample and an anonymized schema 48 hours before the call so we can validate any runtime constraints.
- For the "success criteria" slide, would you accept these example acceptance tests: throughput target (TPS), latency SLA, correctness checks (sample prompts), and data-handling confirmation? I attached a short template we can use to capture these during the meeting.

If Thu 9:00 is locked, I'll hold an SE with screenshare.

— Soojin
